observed.caption: A city skyline with numerous high-rise buildings rises behind a green park with dense trees and an open grassy field under a bright blue sky with scattered white clouds.
observed.description: In the foreground a wide grassy field with patches of light brown and green stretches horizontally, with small bushes at the bottom edge. Behind the field a dense line of green trees and foliage extends across the middle of the image. Beyond the trees an elevated roadway or overpass runs horizontally. In the background a cluster of high-rise buildings of varying heights, colors and designs including brown glass, blue glass, white and gray towers dominates the skyline. The sky above is bright blue with scattered fluffy white clouds. The lighting is bright natural daylight.
